family: OR_n: the Boolean OR function on n bits. f_n(x)=1 iff any input bit x_i is 1, for all n>=0 (with f_0=0). The standard binary OR tree implements it in linear time.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(OR_n) >= 1*n^1 - o(n^1) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li–Yang B2 model. Explicitly C_B2(OR_n) = n-1 for every n>=1.
